mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP demand (GDPC1) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased corporate earnings expectations boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-significant positive 20d returns (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising GDPC1, or when GDP growth decelerates despite high demand.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs reduce corporate profit margins and investor sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4%, or in non-tightening regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals tightening monetary policy coupled with labor market strength, amplifying bearish pressure on S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during periods of rising FEDFUNDS and falling UNRATE, or when the interaction is absent.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, high industrial production (INDPRO) and suppressed inflation (CPIAUCSL) create favorable conditions for S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as corporate profits and investor confidence rise.
failure_condition: SPX returns fail to be significantly positive (p > 0.05) during late-cycle periods with high INDPRO and low CPIAUCSL, or when the regime is not late-cycle.

mechanism_narrative: An inflation spike above 2% in the CPIAUCSL index triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2%, or in non-inflationary regimes.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust demand growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market optimism about corporate earnings and economic activity surges.
failure_condition: SPX returns fail to be significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of rising HOUST and RSAFS, or when the interaction is absent.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery phase, low unemployment rates (UNRATE < 4%) and historically low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) create favorable conditions for S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as market confidence in economic recovery strengthens.
failure_condition: SPX returns fail to be significantly positive (p > 0.05) during post-shock recovery periods with UNRATE < 4% and FEDFUNDS at historical lows, or when the regime is not post-shock.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 140,000 workers triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as strong labor market growth signals robust economic activity and corporate optimism.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods when PAYEMS exceeds 140,000, or in non-strong labor market regimes.
